newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Plane catches fire at Manila airport, no one hurt.
newsitem.headline: Plane catches fire at Manila airport, no one hurt.

text.p: The engine of a domestic-bound commercial airplane, carrying 34 passengers and four crew members, caught fire at Manila airport on Tuesday morning.
Nobody was hurt, an airport official said.
The Air Philippines turbo-prop plane's engine was being started for an early morning flight when its propeller hit the ground power unit, causing its left engine to burst into flames, he said.
Passengers and crewmembers were forced to slide down the emergency chutes, Alfredo Patricio, general manager of the Manila Domestic Airport, told reporters.
The fire was put out after several minutes.
The plane was bound for the central Aklan province.
Patricio said a thorough investigation would be conducted to determine the cause of the accident.
